headline: Apex Industrials Faces Extended Foundry Outage Following Thermal Explosion
body: Production at Apex main steel foundry halted indefinitely as safety inspectors conduct formal review.

headline: Titan Steel Secures $250M Multi-Year Auto Supply Contract
body: Titan Steel Corporation announced exclusive supply contract with major European automotive consortium.

headline: Quantum Semiconductor Discloses 8-Week Yield Contraction
body: Advanced node silicon fabrication yields dipped 4.2% due to chemical supplier purity defects.

headline: Global Logistics Expedites Freight Capacity in Southeast Corridor
body: Global Logistics added 12 regional intermodal routes following port congestion resolution.

headline: Vanguard Auto Lowers FY26 Delivery Targets by 5%
body: Vehicle assembly guidance trimmed citing semiconductor inventory bottlenecks and battery shipping delays.

headline: Solaris Energy Commences Commercial Operation of 400MW Solar Facility
body: Solaris Energy grid interconnect approved ahead of schedule with long-term utility PPA.
